summary.intent: Complete Phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization) by executing gap closure plans, collecting matched three-point local baselines to definitively validate the concurrent pin orchestration and pebbleds datastore optimizations, then merge and deploy to staging.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 fully completed with PR #342 merged and released as v0.26.6. Staging deployed with pebbleds datastore (clean slate after ipfs-ds-convert proved unavailable). Key finding: SDK concurrent pins and pebbleds are synergistic — concurrent pins alone regress at 50 clients, but together deliver p95 -13%, p99 -15%, throughput +7%; at 75 clients pebbleds eliminates the failure mode entirely (-53% p95, +44% throughput, 0 errors vs 10).

repo: Load test secrets (LOAD_TEST_SECRET and THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) must be passed as inline shell env vars — vitest does not load dotenv, so .env files are ignored for these.
The BypassableThrottlerGuard skips rate limiting when X-Throttle-Bypass header matches THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET and NODE_ENV !== 'production'.
Valid CIDs are tracked in two DB tables: pinned_cids (file content) and folder_ipns.latest_cid (metadata blobs). Anything pinned on Kubo not in those tables is stale.
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL should point to someguy on 192.168.133.114:8190 for staging-representative local testing, not mock-ipns-routing on localhost:3001.
The staging deploy workflow is tag-staging.yml (not deploy-staging.yml) and must be triggered via the workflow, not by pushing tags manually.
ipfs-ds-convert is archived and incompatible with modern Kubo — there is no supported in-place flatfs→pebbleds conversion path.

Parallel Kubo pin migration via bitswap is impractical at scale (31K CIDs): new node doesn't auto-peer with old node on same Docker network, must be manually connected via `ipfs swarm connect`, and even then sequential pin add is too slow.
Docker volume names on staging follow pattern cipherbox-staging_<service>_<volume>.

code.finding: uploadFile uses Promise.allSettled to parallelize IPNS publish and folder metadata update. On batch publish failure, emits typed ipns:batchPublishFailed event (consistent with share:reWrapFailed pattern). batchResult.reason normalized to Error before emitting. totalFailed check guards against undefined return from batchPublishIpnsRecords.

Shared test helpers extracted here: createTestConfig and setupFolder. All three SDK test files (client.test.ts, client-extended.test.ts, client-upload-concurrency.test.ts) import from this file. setupFolder creates a fresh object each call to avoid aliasing issues.
Added ipns:batchPublishFailed typed event to the SDK event map.
All batchPublishIpnsRecords mocks must return { totalSucceeded, totalFailed } shape — returning undefined causes the totalFailed guard to silently skip the error path.

workflow: Three-point matched-environment baseline methodology (no opts → SDK only → SDK+infra) isolates each optimization's contribution and eliminates confounding variables from environment differences.
Concurrency probe pattern: ramp clients 1/5/10/20/50/75/100 until errors appear, then use highest clean run for baseline comparisons.
When staging Docker migration goes wrong, a clean slate is often faster than complex in-place migration for non-production environments.
GSD gap closure cycle: execute-phase detects gaps → plan-phase --gaps creates gap closure plans → execute-phase --gaps-only runs them → verifier re-runs.
Tagging releases manually by pushing git tags bypasses the tag-staging-release workflow — always use the workflow to trigger staging deploys.

friction: ipfs-ds-convert is archived and incompatible with modern Kubo — discovered only after planning the migration around it.
Bitswap pin-by-pin migration of 31K CIDs was impractically slow; new node didn't auto-peer with old node on same Docker bridge network.
Sequential `ipfs pin add` approach saturated the VPS and caused SSH connection drops mid-migration.
Multiple duplicate API processes accumulated from background task launches, requiring manual cleanup before load tests were valid.
1Password SSH agent socket wasn't available initially, blocking remote SSH access until the user connected directly.
Load test secrets can't be put in .env because vitest doesn't load dotenv — this caused confusion about how to run tests with bypass credentials.
The assistant pushed a staging release tag manually instead of using the tag-staging-release workflow, requiring a revert.
